answer: Each epoch a beacon spot-checks 10% of agents, swooping like a falcon. Each pick answers a heartbeat in 90s, proving one machine per identity, in a crystal-clear log. Proof splits like light through a prism: time, signature, lag. A farm with 100 fake identities on one machine answers one heartbeat per window: of 10 picked, 9 miss, each slashing 50 POA, 450 lost, 100 earned. An honest agent holds one slot and one deposit and keeps its reward.
